g_policy.reason: The home-feed banner is dismissible, and the offer copy states the 30-minute reward before play. The decline and ad-failure fields leave reading unchanged if the user declines or the play is not confirmed.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 30 minutes without sponsored stories, not cash or a transferable or externally redeemable item.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger event uses a return to the home feed and an article-open counter, not anything the reader wrote or said.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The adds and decline fields leave free reading, saving, and sharing available; opting in temporarily hides sponsored cards rather than locking a free reader feature.

g_brand_safety.reason: The placement is a banner under the category pills on s01, a content-safe home-feed screen, rather than inside a conversation or beside unsafe content.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This product_change adds an ad-free reading window tied to f01, the observed home-feed-to-article reading flow.

c2_evidence.reason: The what-makes-it-work-here field claims an AOL full-screen video ad appears after every third article, which the product model does not support. It also calls the sponsored cards low-value and treats no observed paid plan as proof that every reader is free; neither claim follows from the cited elements or open questions.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward lasts 30 minutes and the frequency cap is two per day, so it does not give away an unlimited subscription benefit.

c5_moment.reason: The trigger event waits until the reader returns to the home feed from an article, rather than interrupting an article in progress.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The flow uses a short sponsored game triggered by a detectable feed return, and the ad-failure field says nothing changes unless the play is confirmed.

c7_specific.reason: The placement and reward name this app's home-feed category pills and sponsored cards, with article advertising also cited at s02.e13.
